task.title: The catalog and My-cards LIST views still cap at 1280px on wide monitors
task.description: Residual of the wide-viewport task (2026-08-16): the card GRID now fills a 2560px monitor, but the shared Table component (components/ui/table.rs) still carries max-w-7xl, so every LIST view — catalog list mode and the My-cards/collection tables — stays ~1280px wide, the same half-the-screen symptom the maintainer originally reported. Un-capping Table affects every table app-wide (column layout, truncation, readability at 2560px), so it needs its own pass: decide whether tables should grow (and how columns flex) or whether a capped table is deliberate typography. See specs/app-ui.md's updated Catalog grid paragraph and the P6-098 findings entry for history.
